Title: Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - July 20, 2026
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm Live Patch Notes - July 20, 2026] New patch arrived with a new skin, map updates, Abathur updates, Alexstrasza updates, Ragnaros updates, Yrel updates, and balance changes! View Full Article

CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Map Rotation:
  • Ranked
    • Haunted Mines added.
    • [Undocumented] Warhead Junction removed.
  Storm League:
  • ~~Placed players can now party with unplaced players.~~
[Bug Fixes]
  • Attack beams from Forts, Keeps, and the Core will now be more visible when attacking Heroes.

=== Battlegrounds: Hanamura Temple ===
[Updates]
  General:
  • Bushes
    • Additional bushes have been added in several locations.

=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Heroes to not auto-mount when using Hearthstone from inside the Mines.

=== Battlegrounds: Warhead Junction ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Warheads
    • Cooldown penalty on interrupt reduced from 10 to 5 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that caused Heroes to not be revealed while launching a Warhead.
  • Fixed an issue that caused the Warhead's channel beam to persist when interrupted.

=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Collection]
  • [Undocumented] Symbiote Abilities are now visible in Collection and Hero Select.
[User Interface]
  Talents:
  • Level 10
    • Evolve Monstrosity
      • Now displays as a Quest.
[Updates]
  Base:
  • [Undocumented] Movement Speed reduced by 2%, from 4.8398 to 4.75.
  • Locust Strain [D]
    • Health reduced from 350 to 225.
    • Locusts no longer have a duration.
    • Locusts now lose [Undocumented] 13 Health per second.
    • [Undocumented] Locusts duration effectively increased from 16 to 17 seconds.
    • Additional functionality: Locusts now heal for 20% of the damage they deal, and heal for 20% of their maximum Health when a nearby [Undocumented] enemy ~~Minion~~ dies.
    • Locust damage reduced from 58 to 36.
    • Locusts now deal 100% bonus damage to non-Heroes.
    • Locusts no longer deal 25% bonus damage to Structures.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Envenomed Nests
      • Armor reduction increased from 10 to 15.
    • Locust Brood
      • Moved from Level 16 to Level 1.
      • Cooldown increased from 45 to 75 seconds.
  • Level 4
    • (New) Slapathur
      • Abathur's Basic Attacks now deal ~~500%~~ 350% bonus damage, Stun ~~non-Heroes for 3 seconds~~ Stun enemies, and disable Structures for 1.5 seconds. The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every 6 seconds.
  • Level 10
    • Evolve Monstrosity
      • Abathur now has a Monstrosity unit frame for tracking Health and stacks of the unit.
  • Level 16
    • Survival Intincts
      • Moved from Level 1 to Level 16.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Monstrosity to heal for 78 instead of 2% current Health when a nearby enemy Minion died.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Dragonqueen [D]
    • Cooldown now starts after Dragonqueen has expired.
    • Cooldown reduced from 150 to 130 seconds.
    • Talents that affect Gift of Life also apply to Breath of Life.
    • Talents that affect Abundance also apply to Preservation.
  • Breath of Life [Dragonqueen Q]
    • Healing reduced from 20% to 15%.
  • Preservation [Dragonqueen W]
    • Healing reduced from 30% to 25%.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Live and Let Live
      • Now also provides 25% recharge rate for Breath of Life.
    • Flames of Fury
      • Cooldown reduction increased from 5 to 6 seconds.
      • New Mythic Reward: Hit an additional 40 Heroes without dying to cause Dragonqueen's duration to be refreshed when damaging an enemy Hero.
  • Level 7
    • Lifeblossom
      • Additional functionality: Now makes Breath of Life remove Slows and Roots.
  • Level 16
    • Overprotective
      • [Undocumented] Preservation does not give any Shield.
    • Draconic Discipline
      • No longer affects Dragonqueen's duration.
      • For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen's Basic Attacks, reduce the cooldown of Preservation by 1.25 seconds.
  • Level 20
    • On Ruby Wings
      • Rework: If at least 3 Heroes are in an area hit by a Fireball, that Fireball charge is not consumed.
    • Ancient Flame
      • Additional functionality: Now also provides additional 25% Health [Undocumented] while in Dragonqueen .
      • Does not provide Quest stacks while active.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing Dragonqueen's transformation to remove the collected Lifeblossom.
